    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    if not out:
        return out
    width = len(out[0])
    for c in range(width):
        if out[-1][c] != 5:
            continue
        color = 0
        for r in range(len(out) - 1, -1, -1):
            if out[r][c] != 0:
                color = out[r][c]
            elif color:
                out[r][c] = color
    return out
'''
